full_judgment:
16. The plaintiff made a prayer in his plaint for a declaration to the effect that the threatened disposal of raw materials of the plaintiff is illegal, but did not make any prayer for injunction restraining the defendant from disposing of raw materials. In such circumstances, the defendant can safely dispose of the raw materials of the plaintiff without any hindrance and therefore, any such decree for declaration will be infructuous. 

 18. By a perusal of the impugned judgment and order of the learned Subordinate Judge dated 3.8.85, it appears that he has stated in his judgment that a mere decree for declaration in such a case without any consequential relief will be a nullity and, as such, the suit would be hit by the provision of section 42 of the Specific Relief Act. On this finding the learned Subordinate Judge has rejected the plaint under Order 7 rule 11 CPC.
